Warcraft II Trigger Studio 1.44.0 — Complete Feature Manual

1046 canonical trigger primitives: 666 actions + 380 conditions.
Every visible primitive has an editor schema, feature description, multiplayer classification, parameter documentation, and a dedicated validated example. M is the conservative multiplayer-eligible badge.
Trigger-level customization available to every trigger: executing players, enabled state, comment, All/Any condition mode, start delay, Preserve/repeat, repeat interval, and Max runs. Conditions also expose NOT/invert unless the condition is Always/Never.

MGame Message Action

Flow & messages

Displays Warcraft's native game-information slot. The selected color is written to the exact renderer-owned system color byte after map_msg resets it. Repeat is controlled by the trigger Preserve setting.

M — multiplayer-eligible. For simulation-changing triggers, every participating client should run the same Trigger Studio version and the same sidecar so execution stays deterministic.

Dedicated example: examples/actions/002_Game_Message.w2trig.json
Example trigger: 10 - TEST ACTION - Game Message
Expected/test notes: AUTOMATIC/SETUP TEST: the profile supplies common setup where practical. Displays Warcraft's native game-information slot. The selected color is written to the exact renderer-owned system color byte after map_msg resets it. Repeat is controlled by the trigger Preserve setting.

Customization / parameters

JSON keyEditor labelTypeDefaultOptionalDocumentation
textMessage templatemessage_template'Round started!'NoUses Warcraft's native game-information slot. Remaster stores the line's starting color in a dedicated byte, while raw 0x01-0x06 controls inside the text change color inline. [yellow], [white], [red], [gray], [game], and [previous] map to those native controls. Variables such as {count(Current|Footman|Anywhere)}, {gold}, {kills(P1|All)}, {elapsed}, and {run} expand when the action fires. The network text remains printable; the local native HUD slot receives the colors. To show this again, enable 'Repeat / preserve this trigger' in the main Trigger settings and use Max runs 0 for unlimited repeats.
colorStarting information colorchoice'Yellow / gold — native normal'NoSets the native per-slot renderer color for the whole game-information line. Supported values: Native sender color — no override, Yellow / gold — native normal, White — native highlight, Red — native selected / warning, Gray — native disabled, Game yellow — native game palette
recipientsRecipientschoice'Local player only'NoLocal uses Warcraft's one native game-information HUD slot. All/Player choices also send printable PM_STRING text to matching network players. Supported values: Local player only, All active players, Player 1, Player 2, Player 3, Player 4, Player 5, Player 6, Player 7, Player 8
secondsDisplay secondsint4NoHow long the local in-game information message remains visible. A later Game Message replaces the same native slot.
also_logAlso write to Trigger Studio logboolTrueNoEnable or disable this option for the feature. Default: True.

MPlayer Chat Action

Flow & messages

Sends a real Warcraft player-chat line through PM_STRING and the native rolling chat queue. The selected color is written to the exact renderer-owned color byte for the final rotating slot.

M — multiplayer-eligible. For simulation-changing triggers, every participating client should run the same Trigger Studio version and the same sidecar so execution stays deterministic.

Dedicated example: examples/actions/003_Player_Chat.w2trig.json
Example trigger: 10 - TEST ACTION - Player Chat
Expected/test notes: AUTOMATIC/SETUP TEST: the profile supplies common setup where practical. Sends a real Warcraft player-chat line through PM_STRING and the native rolling chat queue. The selected color is written to the exact renderer-owned color byte for the final rotating slot.

Customization / parameters

JSON keyEditor labelTypeDefaultOptionalDocumentation
textChat message templatechat_template'Attack now!'NoSends an actual native Warcraft player-chat line. Local chat enters through the source-matched rolling insertion routine. Its dedicated base-color byte controls the starting color, while [yellow], [white], [red], [gray], [game], and [previous] remain raw inline 0x01-0x06 controls. Variables such as {count(Current|Footman|Anywhere)}, {gold}, {elapsed}, and {run} expand when the action fires. The final text, including color-control bytes, may use at most 78 CP1252 bytes. Repeating chat requires 'Repeat / preserve this trigger' in the main Trigger settings; Max runs 0 means unlimited.
senderChat senderchoice'Current trigger player'NoCurrent trigger player uses the player currently executing this trigger. Local player uses Warcraft's gbLocalPlayer. Explicit senders support Player 1 through Player 8. Supported values: Current trigger player, Local player, Player 1, Player 2, Player 3, Player 4, Player 5, Player 6, Player 7, Player 8
colorStarting chat colorchoice'Native sender color — no override'NoWrites Warcraft's final native rolling-chat color byte after the slot is selected. Supported values: Native sender color — no override, Yellow / gold — native normal, White — native highlight, Red — native selected / warning, Gray — native disabled, Game yellow — native game palette
recipientsRecipientschoice'All active players'NoLocal displays only on this Warcraft instance. All/Player choices send the native PM_STRING packet to matching network recipients and also display locally when applicable. Supported values: Local player only, All active players, Player 1, Player 2, Player 3, Player 4, Player 5, Player 6, Player 7, Player 8
also_logAlso write to Trigger Studio logboolTrueNoEnable or disable this option for the feature. Default: True.

LOCAL / CAUTIONWait Action

Flow & messages

Delays only the actions below it. The scheduler resumes later without blocking the editor or Warcraft.

No M badge — treat this as local-only, timing/random-sensitive, inferred edge logic, debugger/tooling, or an unverified native UI/media surface.

Dedicated example: examples/actions/004_Wait.w2trig.json
Example trigger: 10 - TEST ACTION - Wait
Expected/test notes: AUTOMATIC/SETUP TEST: the profile supplies common setup where practical. Delays only the actions below it. The scheduler resumes later without blocking the editor or Warcraft.

Customization / parameters

JSON keyEditor labelTypeDefaultOptionalDocumentation
secondsSecondsduration1NoPauses only the remaining actions in this trigger. It is non-blocking and never sleeps Warcraft's main thread.

MOrder Action

Units & buildings

Queues a native Move, destination Attack, or Patrol order. Attack uses only X/Y, never Patrol or trigger-selected enemy fields. Empty wave owners remain Empty while a runtime route tracker hands nearby enemies to Warcraft's native targeted Attack path and resumes the destination afterward. Repeating triggers skip unchanged routes by default.

M — multiplayer-eligible. For simulation-changing triggers, every participating client should run the same Trigger Studio version and the same sidecar so execution stays deterministic.

MCast Spell Action

Spells, missiles & sound

Uses Warcraft's native spell paths with native-aware eligibility. Unit-target spells reserve distinct targets per caster, skip busy casters and invalid/already-affected targets, and expose nearest/health priority controls. Healing never casts on full-health units. Native hero equivalents are accepted: Khadgar as a Mage; Turalyon/Uther as Paladins; Teron/Gul'dan as Death Knights; Dentarg/Cho'gall as Ogre-Mages. Ground-target spells can use a location, coordinates, or matching unit tiles.

M — multiplayer-eligible. For simulation-changing triggers, every participating client should run the same Trigger Studio version and the same sidecar so execution stays deterministic.

Dedicated example: examples/actions/025_Cast_Spell.w2trig.json
Example trigger: 10 - TEST ACTION - Cast Spell
Expected/test notes: AUTOMATIC/SETUP TEST: the profile supplies common setup where practical. Uses Warcraft's native spell paths with native-aware eligibility. Unit-target spells reserve distinct targets per caster, skip busy casters and invalid/already-affected targets, and expose nearest/health priority controls. Healing never casts on full-health units. Native hero equivalents are accepted: Khadgar as a Mage; Turalyon/Uther as Paladins; Teron/Gul'dan as Death Knights; Dentarg/Cho'gall as Ogre-Mages. Ground-target spells can use a location, coordinates, or matching unit tiles.

Supported values: Runes, Holy Vision, Blizzard, Fireball, Slow, Flame Shield, Invisibility, Polymorph, Eye of Kilrogg, Bloodlust, Healing, Exorcism, Raise Dead, Death Coil, Whirlwind, Death and Decay, Haste, Unholy Armor

matrixAlliance for every playeralliance_matrix{}NoEach row is one player. Check every player that row should be allied with. Unchecked cross-player cells are enemies. Self-cells are locked on and cannot be undone.

MSet Shared Vision Action

Players & diplomacy

Use the 8x8 checkbox grid directly: each row is the vision source and each checked column receives that player’s vision. Self-vision is locked on. Offline Computer vision uses a private vision-mode byte read only by fog and unit-visibility routines, while the real command mode remains offline. Warcraft performs one native cache initialization when the matrix changes and no repeating rebuild.

M — multiplayer-eligible. For simulation-changing triggers, every participating client should run the same Trigger Studio version and the same sidecar so execution stays deterministic.

MEnable Auto Spellcasting Action

Automatic spell combat

Enables smart spells for Mage, Paladin, Ogre-Mage, Death Knight, and caster heroes. Only a caster with a valid spell pauses for one cast; its saved combat route resumes afterward. Healing and Flame Shield use atomic source-equivalent effects while remaining spells use native do_unit_spell.

M — multiplayer-eligible. For simulation-changing triggers, every participating client should run the same Trigger Studio version and the same sidecar so execution stays deterministic.

Dedicated example: examples/actions/106_Enable_Auto_Spellcasting.w2trig.json
Example trigger: 10 - TEST ACTION - Enable Auto Spellcasting
Expected/test notes: AUTOMATIC/SETUP TEST: the profile supplies common setup where practical. Enables smart spells for Mage, Paladin, Ogre-Mage, Death Knight, and caster heroes. Only a caster with a valid spell pauses for one cast; its saved combat route resumes afterward. Healing and Flame Shield use atomic source-equivalent effects while remaining spells use native do_unit_spell.

Customization / parameters

MScene Choice Action

Cutscene speech & local input 1.31

Displays 2-4 numbered choices and blocks until the local player presses 1-4. Stores the selected option number in a trigger variable for branching. Optional Windows TTS can read the prompt and choices aloud.

M — multiplayer-eligible. For simulation-changing triggers, every participating client should run the same Trigger Studio version and the same sidecar so execution stays deterministic.
